description: AI Laser Scanner Master 48 Candlestick Patterns & Technical Confluence Knowledge Base

patterns.name: Bullish Engulfing
patterns.rule: Small red candle followed by a large green candle that completely covers and engulfs the previous red body.

patterns.name: Morning Star
patterns.rule: 3-candle pattern: large red candle + small doji/spinning star + strong green candle closing deep into the first red candle.

patterns.name: Hammer
patterns.rule: Small body at the top with a long lower shadow (2-3 times body length) rejecting lower prices at support.

patterns.name: Inverted Hammer
patterns.rule: Small body at the bottom with long upper shadow at support indicating buyers testing higher prices.

patterns.name: Bullish Pin Bar
patterns.rule: Sharp rejection tail piercing support and closing with green body or high wick rejection.

patterns.name: Dragonfly Doji
patterns.rule: Open, high, and close at nearly the same upper level with a very long lower shadow.

patterns.name: Piercing Line
patterns.rule: Large red candle followed by a green candle opening lower and closing above 50% of the red candle's body.

patterns.name: Three White Soldiers
patterns.rule: Three consecutive strong bullish green candles with consecutive higher closes and small wicks.

patterns.name: Tweezer Bottom
patterns.rule: Two consecutive candles (first red, second green) with matching lows at support.

patterns.name: Inside Bar False Breakout (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Seller stop-hunting fakeout dipping below mother bar at support then closing aggressively back inside green.

patterns.name: Bullish Harami
patterns.rule: Large red candle followed by a small green candle completely contained inside the body of the previous red candle.

patterns.name: Bullish Marubozu
patterns.rule: Solid green candle with little to no shadows representing total buyers dominance.

patterns.name: Morning Doji Star
patterns.rule: Large red candle + narrow doji star gapping down + large green candle confirming the upward reversal.

patterns.name: Bullish Kicker
patterns.rule: Red candle followed immediately by green candle opening at or above the previous open with strong upward surge.

patterns.name: Three Inside Up
patterns.rule: Red candle + bullish inside bar + third green candle closing above the first candle's high.

patterns.name: Rising Three Methods
patterns.rule: Long green candle + 3 small pullback red candles staying inside its range + powerful green continuation candle.

patterns.name: Support Level Bounce
patterns.rule: Candle touches major horizontal support level or psychological round number and rejects with bullish response.

patterns.name: Breakout & Retest (Bullish)
patterns.rule: Previous resistance broken upward, candle pulls back to touch broken line as new support and closes green.

patterns.name: 21 EMA Dynamic Support Bounce
patterns.rule: Pullback in healthy uptrend touches the 21 EMA curve and bounces with bullish wick rejection.

patterns.name: Fibonacci 50%-61.8% Golden Bounce
patterns.rule: Retracement of recent bullish impulse lands squarely on 50% or 61.8% Fibonacci level and prints bullish reversal.

patterns.name: Double Bottom (W Pattern)
patterns.rule: Second swing low holds equal or higher at support, forming W bottom with breakout candle.

patterns.name: Ascending Trendline Bounce
patterns.rule: Higher-low pullback touches valid ascending trendline for 3rd or 4th touch and forms bullish rejection.

patterns.name: Bullish Engulfing Retracement
patterns.rule: Small red retracement candle after bullish engulfing respects open level and closes green continuation.

patterns.name: Seller Exhaustion Climax Reversal
patterns.rule: Abnormally large red candle hitting major support followed by sharp wick recovery showing sellers exhaustion.

patterns.name: Bearish Engulfing
patterns.rule: Small green candle followed by a large red candle that completely covers and engulfs the previous green body.

patterns.name: Evening Star
patterns.rule: 3-candle pattern: large green candle + small doji/spinning star + strong red candle closing deep into the first green candle.

patterns.name: Shooting Star
patterns.rule: Small body at the bottom with a long upper shadow (2-3 times body length) rejecting higher prices at resistance.

patterns.name: Hanging Man
patterns.rule: Small body at the top of an uptrend with a long lower shadow showing early seller entry at resistance.

patterns.name: Bearish Pin Bar
patterns.rule: Sharp rejection tail piercing resistance and closing with red body or upper wick rejection.

patterns.name: Gravestone Doji
patterns.rule: Open, low, and close at nearly the same lower level with a very long upper shadow.

patterns.name: Dark Cloud Cover
patterns.rule: Large green candle followed by a red candle opening higher and closing below 50% of the green candle's body.

patterns.name: Three Black Crows
patterns.rule: Three consecutive strong bearish red candles with consecutive lower closes and small wicks.

patterns.name: Tweezer Top
patterns.rule: Two consecutive candles (first green, second red) with matching highs at resistance.

patterns.name: Inside Bar False Breakout (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Buyer bull-trap fakeout spiking above mother bar at resistance then closing aggressively back inside red.

patterns.name: Bearish Harami
patterns.rule: Large green candle followed by a small red candle completely contained inside the body of the previous green candle.

patterns.name: Bearish Marubozu
patterns.rule: Solid red candle with little to no shadows representing total sellers dominance.

patterns.name: Evening Doji Star
patterns.rule: Large green candle + narrow doji star gapping up + large red candle confirming the downward reversal.

patterns.name: Bearish Kicker
patterns.rule: Green candle followed immediately by red candle opening at or below the previous open with strong downward drop.

patterns.name: Three Inside Down
patterns.rule: Green candle + bearish inside bar + third red candle closing below the first candle's low.

patterns.name: Falling Three Methods
patterns.rule: Long red candle + 3 small pullback green candles staying inside its range + powerful red continuation candle.

patterns.name: Resistance Level Rejection
patterns.rule: Candle touches major horizontal resistance level or psychological round number and rejects with bearish response.

patterns.name: Breakdown & Retest (Bearish)
patterns.rule: Previous support broken downward, candle pulls back to touch broken line as new resistance and closes red.

patterns.name: 21 EMA Dynamic Resistance Rejection
patterns.rule: Pullback in healthy downtrend touches the 21 EMA curve and rejects with bearish upper wick.

patterns.name: Fibonacci 50%-61.8% Golden Rejection
patterns.rule: Retracement of recent bearish impulse lands squarely on 50% or 61.8% Fibonacci level and prints bearish rejection.

patterns.name: Double Top (M Pattern)
patterns.rule: Second swing high fails to break previous peak at resistance, forming M top with breakdown candle.

patterns.name: Descending Trendline Rejection
patterns.rule: Lower-high pullback touches valid descending trendline for 3rd or 4th touch and forms bearish rejection.

patterns.name: Bearish Engulfing Continuation
patterns.rule: Small green pullback candle after bearish engulfing fails to break open level and closes red continuation.

patterns.name: Buyer Exhaustion Climax Reversal
patterns.rule: Abnormally large green candle hitting major resistance followed by sharp wick drop showing buyers exhaustion.
